detail.finding: the cortex error_log TABLE is only readable when cortex is up and the store loads — untrue during exactly the failures worth reading. The five CRASHED suites printed stack traces to stdout and nowhere queryable.
detail.built: append-only data/error.log, one canonical ledger row per line, dependency-free.

intent: a readable error record that outlives the systems it reports on

detail.defect: a circular detail made JSON.stringify(entry) throw; the catch prevented a crash but dropped the whole row.
detail.why_it_matters: a silently lost error is the worst failure an error log can have
detail.fix: detail degrades to a stated _unserializable marker; the row still lands
detail.pinned_by: EL-004 (asserts the row SURVIVES, not merely that nothing throws)
